mapper.select: SELECT ft.id, ft.task_no, ft.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, ft.doctor_id, u.name AS doctor_name, ft.task_type, ft.task_content, ft.plan_date, ft.actual_date, ft.status, ft.priority, ft.creator_id, u2.name AS creator_name, ft.assign_date, ft.remarks, CASE ft.status WHEN 'pending' THEN '待办' WHEN 'in_progress' THEN '进行中' WHEN 'completed' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN '已取消' ELSE ft.status END AS status_name, CASE ft.priority WHEN 'low' THEN '低' WHEN 'normal' THEN '正常' WHEN 'high' THEN '高' ELSE ft.priority END AS priority_name FROM followup_task ft LEFT JOIN patient p ON ft.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON ft.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON ft.creator_id = u2.id WHERE ft.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_task (task_no, patient_id, doctor_id, task_type, task_content, plan_date, status, priority, creator_id, assign_date, remarks) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{taskType}, #{taskContent}, #{planDate}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{creatorId}, #{assignDate}, #{remarks})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_task WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_task WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND status = #{status}
